english:
Disorients PVE Combatants for 10 seconds, preventing them from attacking or using abilities.

Removes Players' HUD, whitens their screen, and distorts their audio for 3 seconds.

Stuns <unstoppable/>Unstoppable Champions.

<link Champions, Hive Lightbearers, Bosses, and non-single-seater Vehicles [#CombatantClassifications] /> are immune to being Disoriented, but still count as <arc Blinded /> targets for other interactions.

source.text:
Blinded Combatants are disoriented, rendering them unable to attack or use abilities for 10 seconds.

Blinded Guardians have their HUD removed, screen whitened, and audio distorted for 3 seconds.

Unstoppable Champions become Stunned upon being Blinded.
